_comment: Items that are mission/engine placeholders, not player-obtainable. Excluded from Inventory > Resources and from the acquisition-research scope. This is the single documented exception to 'Inventory is the full catalog'. Add entries only on the user's decision.

items.name: Auto Shared Dog Tag
items.reason: Mission placeholder: an animal capture that is shared with the whole squad. Not player-obtainable; no wiki page.

items.name: Skateweed Extract
items.reason: The item does not exist in the game; omitted (user decision).

items.name: Braton Blueprint
items.reason: The blueprint itself does not exist as an item; only the finished Braton can be purchased (user decision).

items.name: Glyph Prism
items.reason: Given at the start of the game; lets a glyph be displayed in missions. Not an attainable item (user decision).

items.name: Last Chance Offerings
items.reason: Appears in the worldstate only as a FeaturedItem label in Varzia's rotation schedule, not as an item (user decision: exclude if the worldstate does not identify an item).
